name: a card table in a quiet room: a pale panelled wall with a pendant lamp, a plant on a shelf, a window and a wall clock, a dark felt table top with a wooden edge, two stacks of chips, and a dark wall board that shows a number
fits: anything about playing cards, dealing and shuffling, dice and games of chance, counting arrangements or odds with an everyday table game; the hero is the deck standing on the felt, the camera pans along the table and up to the wall board
recipe: flat 2D front view (no iso): a wall rect and a wainscot band that bleed past the frame, a felt band with a lighter pool under the lamp, a wood edge and an apron, chips as rounded bars in a stack, the deck as a pile of face-on cards each offset down-right so its ledges show, a half of the deck tinted blue and the other half red so a riffle reads as stripes, a dark board with a rolling number
